column1: REGISTRATION  OF  TITLE ACT, No.  21 OF  1998
Declaration  of  Determination  of  the  Commissioner  of  Title  Settlement  under  Section  14

B
Y virtue of the powers vested in me under Section 14 of the Registration of Title Act, No.21 of 1998, I, the undersigned, hereby de-
clare my determination as set out in the Schedule appended hereto in regard to the  title to parcel of Land Nos. 8, 9, 87, 96, 106 and 108
of Block 02, contained in the Cadastral Map No. 830185, situated in the Village of Aranwela North within the Grama Niladhari Divi-
sion of No. 334 - Aranwela North in the Divisional Secretary's Division of Beliatta, in the District of Hambantota, in the Province of
Southern, referred to in Notice No. 83/0294 calling for claims to land parcels which was duly published in the Gazette No. 2107/19 of
22nd January, 2019 in terms of Section 12 of the Registration of Title Act, No.21 of 1998.
